R581.note: session_regenerate_id(true) placed after credential verification and before authenticated state is written; nothing else changed.

R583.note: createCipher replaced with pbkdf2-derived key plus random IV via createCipheriv; the added iv/salt response fields are necessary for decryption and are stated plainly.

R589.note: bytesSent captured before reset(); return value unchanged and no other behaviour altered.

R590.note: PreparedStatement with ? and setString; output and error handling unchanged (setString against a numeric id column is driver-tolerated on the common engines).

R591.note: Quoting with doubled quotes stops the plain metacharacter break-out but not batch re-parsing: cmd expands %VAR% (e.g. %CMDCMDLINE%, which contains quotes) in the argument, CR/LF are not rejected, and a script using %~2 loses the quote parity, so the vector is only partly closed; the quoting change is stated.

R592.note: SLF4J {} substitution does not encode CR/LF or other control characters, so forged entries still land in the log exactly as before; contract (ERROR with exception, 401) is preserved.

R593.note: Path.GetFileName plus extension allowlist closes the vector, but the allowlist is an invented set (.pdf/.jpg/.png/.txt/.docx/.xlsx) that now rejects uploads the contract did not exclude; stated, so 1.

R594.note: csrf-csrf middleware is the right shape but ships a hardcoded fallback secret ('default-secret-change-me') and no route ever issues a token, so every legitimate POST is rejected and the failure goes to Express's error handler as HTML rather than the contract's 403 JSON - none of which the write-up states.

R595.note: Magic-byte allowlist plus GUID filename closes the vector, but restricting to PNG/JPEG/GIF/PDF and adding a 10 MB cap rejects uploads the contract did not exclude; changes are stated, so 1.
